example.cn: 我们一意识到出了问题，就立即把孩子们转移开了。

example.cn: 我认为你作出了正确的决定。

example.cn: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

example.cn: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

example.en: a night of wind and rain
example.cn: 风雨交加的夜晚

example.en: See if you can solve this riddle .

example.en: a rude remark
example.cn: 粗鲁的话

example.cn: 请留在座位上，直到灯全都亮起。

example.cn: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

example.cn: 一个小女孩从她身边匆匆经过。

example.cn: 在大多数人退休的年纪，他准备要面对一项新事业。

example.cn: 一把12英寸的尺子

example.cn: 判断能力

example.cn: 这个目标能够实现吗？

example.cn: 你为什么不把真相告诉我们？

example.cn: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

example.cn: 这篇论文大部分我都得重写。

example.cn: 一个偏远的边境小镇

example.cn: 我知道我对明天的考试准备不足。

example.cn: 他转动双肩。

example.cn: 这座教堂在上个世纪全面重建。

example.cn: 撕下旧墙纸，把墙上的洞都填平。

example.cn: 彻底改革税收制度的计划

example.cn: 每小时50英里的限速

example.cn: 电动剃须刀

example.cn: 工会代表

example.cn: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

example.cn: 洗个淋浴你就凉快了。

example.cn: 美国宪法保证宗教信仰自由。

example.en: a paint roller
example.cn: 刷漆滚筒

cn: 收据； 收到， 接收
enDef: a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something

example.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
example.cn: 保留收据以备退货之需。

cn: [数] 随机的；任意的；胡乱的

example.cn: 公司已实行对雇员的随机毒品测试。

enDef: a feeling of comfort when something frightening, worrying, or painful has ended or has not happened

cn: 粗糙的；粗略的；粗野的；艰苦的；未经加工的
enDef: having an uneven surface

example.en: Her hands were rough from hard work.
example.cn: 她的双手因为干重活而变得很粗糙。

enDef: someone whose job is to welcome and deal with people arriving in a hotel or office building, visiting a doctor etc

example.cn: 那些发现了镭元素的科学家，并不知道这种元素会让他们丧命。

example.cn: 前德意志联邦共和国

enDef: a relay race

example.cn: 一百米接力赛

enDef: to make a  cassette  tape or  video  go backwards in order to see or hear it again

example.cn: 请你把这些线重新绕在线轴儿上好吗?。

cn: 不管， 不顾； 不加理会
enDef: without being affected or influenced by something

example.cn: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

enDef: to send something in a different direction

example.en: The flight was redirected to Cleveland.
example.cn: 航班改道飞向克利夫兰。

enDef: something that someone needs or asks for

enDef: an official rule or order

example.en: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
example.cn: 如今好像条条框框很多。

enDef: if a person or a thing is reflected in a mirror, glass, or water, you can see an image of the person or thing on the surface of the mirror, glass, or water

example.cn: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

cn: 修理；[会计] 修理费；备件；修理工作（repair的复数形式）
enDef: A repair is something that you do to mend a machine, building, piece of clothing, or other thing that has been damaged or is not working properly

example.en: Many women know how to make repairs on their cars.
example.cn: 很多女性知道如何修理汽车。

enDef: relating to religion in general or to a particular religion

example.en: I don’t share her religious beliefs .
example.cn: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

enDef: the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past

example.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
example.cn: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

example.cn: 1789年法国大革命

enDef: someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on

example.cn: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

enDef: if two things relate, they are connected in some way

example.en: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
example.cn: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

cn: 奖赏； 报答； 报酬； 回报
enDef: something that you get because you have done something good or helpful or have worked hard

example.cn: 学校有奖惩制度以鼓励良好行为。

cn: 涉及； 参考； 证明书

example.cn: 详尽的参考书目清单

example.en: The song has rhyming couplets (= pairs of lines that end in words that rhyme ) .

example.cn: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

enDef: a feeling of admiring someone or what they do, especially because of their personal qualities, knowledge, or skills

example.en: The boys showed a complete lack of respect for authority.
example.cn: 这些男孩子根本无视权威。

enDef: If you rid a place or person of something undesirable or unwanted, you succeed in removing it completely from that place or person

example.en: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
example.cn: 这些提议是使该国摆脱政治腐败的一种尝试。

enDef: to make someone remember something that they must do

example.en: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
example.cn: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

cn: 王室的， 皇家的； 第一流的
enDef: relating to or belonging to a king or queen

example.en: the royal palace
example.cn: 王宫

cn: 仲裁人， 调解人； 裁判员
enDef: someone who makes sure that the rules of a sport such as football,  basketball  , or  boxing  , are followed

example.en: His headmaster agreed to act as his referee.
example.cn: 他的校长同意做他的推荐人。

enDef: an activity that you do for pleasure or amusement

example.en: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
example.cn: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

enDef: to decay by a gradual natural process, or to make something do this

example.en: Candy will rot your teeth.
example.cn: 吃糖会腐蚀牙齿。

enDef: to say that something or someone is good, or suggest them for a particular purpose or job

example.en: I recommend the butter chicken - it’s delicious.
example.cn: 我推荐黄油焗鸡，非常好吃。

enDef: ripe fruit or crops are fully grown and ready to eat

example.en: Those tomatoes aren’t ripe yet.
example.cn: 那些番茄还没熟。

enDef: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them

example.en: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
example.cn: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

enDef: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly

example.en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
example.cn: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

enDef: someone whose job is to write about news events for a newspaper, or to tell people about them on television or on the radio

example.en: a news reporter
example.cn: 新闻记者

enDef: the amount of rain that falls on an area in a particular period of time

example.en: We’ve had a long period of low rainfall.
example.cn: 我们已有很长一段时间雨量偏低。

enDef: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something

example.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
example.cn: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

enDef: something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed

example.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
example.cn: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

example.cn: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

cn: 迂回的，绕道的；圆滚滚的

example.en: The bus took a very long and roundabout route .
example.cn: 公共汽车路线很长，绕着圈子走。

enDef: not seen or found very often, or not happening very often

example.en: This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
example.cn: 这种植物越来越罕见。

example.cn: 我从来都不认为他好。

cn: 合理的，公道的；通情达理的

example.cn: 合情合理的要求

enDef: to make something smaller or less in size, amount, or price

example.cn: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

cn: 储备，储存；自然保护区；预备队；缄默；[金融] 储备金

example.en: $10 million in cash reserves
example.cn: 1,000万美元的现金储备

enDef: someone who writes about new books, plays, films etc in a newspaper or magazine

example.cn: …《大西洋月刊》的评论员。

enDef: directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered

example.en: Relevant documents were presented in court.
example.cn: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

example.cn: 种族歧视的受害者

example.cn: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

enDef: When you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again

example.en: He is recovering from a knee injury.
example.cn: 他的膝伤正在痊愈。

cn: 放射； 放射物； 放射疗法

example.cn: 防晒霜可隔离有害的紫外线辐射。

example.cn: 72 度到85度之间的温度范围

example.cn: 长跑运动员

example.cn: 请转达我对他的问候。

example.cn: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

example.en: the distinction between fantasy and reality
example.cn: 幻想和现实之间的区别

example.cn: 自动调谐的超高频信号接收器现普遍使用在小汽车上。

cn: 点心；[食品] 茶点；小吃

example.cn: 将提供午餐和茶点。

example.cn: 她的国家因为她拒绝接受变革而受了害。

example.cn: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

example.cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以供再利用。

cn: 屋顶；最高处，顶部；最高限度

example.cn: 他们最后在屋顶上找到了那只猫。

example.cn: 他看上去是不是一个头脑清醒而理智的人？

enDef: to change the position or order of things

example.en: She set about rearranging the furniture in the living room.
example.cn: 她开始重新摆放起居室的家具。

example.cn: 20世纪80年代初的经济衰退

example.cn: 该充电器可在约25分钟内完成给电池充电。

cn: 集合， 团结； 恢复， 重新振作

example.cn: 为政党争取支持的努力

enDef: to find new people to work in a company, join an organization, do a job etc

example.en: We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
example.cn: 我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。

example.cn: 草药用于调制清凉饮料已有几百年的历史了。

example.cn: 飞机在迪拜加过油。

example.cn: 我们定期见面，每月一次。

example.cn: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

example.en: Police arrested several men, who were later released.
example.cn: 警察逮捕了几个人，后来都释放了。

enDef: to reduce someone’s pain or unpleasant feelings

example.en: Drugs helped to relieve the pain.
example.cn: 药物有助于舒缓疼痛。

enDef: slow and unwilling

example.cn: 她勉强笑了笑。

example.cn: 治疗喉咙疼痛的家庭疗法

enDef: to give something to someone or do something, because it is your duty or because someone expects you to

example.cn: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

enDef: to begin doing something again after a period of not doing it

example.cn: 当地居民再一次作出努力，挽救这所学校。

example.cn: 正如一位当地居民在五月份对它的描述”白天有政府。

example.cn: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

enDef: feeling or showing respect

example.en: They listened in respectful silence.
example.cn: 他们毕恭毕敬地静听。

enDef: if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed

example.cn: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

example.cn: 我得补充冷冻柜里的东西了。

example.cn: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

example.cn: 8.99英镑的零售价

enDef: something you do in order to punish someone who has harmed or offended you

example.cn: 攻击者被称是在报复一名14岁男孩，称他是学校一霸。

enDef: money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services

example.cn: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

example.en: Their riotous behaviour led to their arrest.
example.cn: 他们因暴乱行为被捕。

enDef: if something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a process or job

example.en: This vaccine is already routinely used.
example.cn: 这种疫苗的使用已经常规化。

example.en: ...parks and other recreational facilities.
example.cn: …公园及其它娱乐设施。

example.cn: 人类生殖系统

example.cn: 一个解决办法是对长期失业的人进行再培训。

enDef: something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened or been said

example.cn: 他的第一反应是不相信。

example.cn: 难民正涌过边境。

example.cn: 对国防需求的缜密分析

enDef: to think about something again carefully in order to decide whether to change your opinion or judgment about it

example.cn: 这件事让我们重新审视了我们的规划方式。

example.cn: 你将如何重新定义它们？

example.cn: 整个审判过程中，他没有表示出一丝悔意。

enDef: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place, often secretly

example.cn: 秘密约会的计划

enDef: known and admired by a lot of people, especially for a special skill, achievement, or quality

example.cn: 这个地区以其罗马式教堂闻名。

example.cn: 战后，战俘被遣返。

enDef: to be sorry for something and wish you had not done it – used especially when considering your actions in a religious way

example.cn: 他说，那些不肯悔悟的人将受到惩罚。

enDef: If something rekindles an interest, feeling, or thought that you used to have, it makes you think about it or feel it again

example.cn: 本•布兰特利关于伊恩•麦凯伦爵士的文章唤回许多记忆。

example.cn: 一名不服管教的学生

example.cn: 乐队将重聚作美国巡演。

example.cn: 美国和英国对经济复苏有所期待。

cn: 局部范围的； 地方的， 区域性的； 全地区的， 整个地区的
enDef: relating to a particular region or area

example.en: local and regional government
example.cn: 地方及区域治理

cn: 回报， 回应； 报答
enDef: to do or give something, because something similar has been done or given to you

example.en: When he spoke I was expected to reciprocate with some remark of my own.
example.cn: 他在说话时，我也应该说点什么回应他。

example.cn: 很高的报酬

cn: 重新规划； 重新建设

example.cn: 中心城区的改造

example.cn: 他们雇用一个小公司重新油漆饭厅。

example.cn: 还需要更多的疫苗来补充我们的储备。

cn: 重复， 复现或复制； 再制造； 再生
enDef: if you replicate someone’s work, a scientific study etc, you do it again, or try to get the same result again

example.en: There is a need for further research to replicate these findings.
example.cn: 需要进一步的研究来验证这些结果。

cn: 机器人的； 像机器人的， 呆板而机械的

example.cn: 航天飞机的机械臂

example.cn: 遭受内战重创的国家

example.cn: 第二天上午他仍在大叫大嚷。

cn: 重新安置， 搬迁， 迁移
enDef: if a person or business relocates, or if they are relocated, they move to a different place

example.cn: 如果公司要迁移，大多数员工得搬家。

enDef: the ability of a substance such as rubber to return to its original shape after it has been pressed or bent

example.cn: 小提琴圆润悠扬的音色

cn: 呼吸作用；一次呼吸；植物光合作用
enDef: the process of breathing

example.cn: 一天当中，他的呼吸越来越微弱。

cn: 沉默寡言的；言不如意的
enDef: unwilling to talk about what you feel or what you know

example.en: She is so reticent about her achievements.
example.cn: 她对于自己的成就如此缄默。

cn: 精巧的附件， 精制的改良品； 精炼； 文雅
enDef: the process of improving something

example.en: Some further refinement is needed.
example.cn: 需要进一步的改进。

cn: 报复， 反击； 复仇
enDef: to do something bad to someone because they have done something bad to you

example.en: I was sorely tempted to retaliate.
example.cn: 我非常想报复。

cn: 重新包装； 重新填塞； 再装配； 拆修

enDef: a fixed amount of something that people are allowed to have when there is not enough, for example during a war

example.en: emergency food rations
example.cn: 紧急食物配给

cn: 使重新振作； 使恢复活力
enDef: to put vitality and vigour back into (someone or something)

example.en: The good news for committed shoppers is a so-called 'soft break' – a few minutes rest grabbing a coffee, for example - can reinvigorate our senses, although only temporarily.
example.cn: 对于那些热衷购物的人来说，好消息是，稍事休息一下——比如花几分钟喝杯咖啡——可以使我们的感官重新振作，虽然这仅是暂时的。

enDef: to take an examination again, because you failed it or did not do well enough

example.en: Those who fail can resit the exam in 60 days.
example.cn: 考试不及格的人可以在60天后重考。

enDef: to lie or lean back in a relaxed way

example.en: She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue.
example.cn: 她开始斜靠在一个躺椅上。

enDef: when people vote in order to make a decision about a particular subject, rather than voting for a person

example.en: The city council agreed to hold a referendum on the issue in November.
example.cn: 市政会同意在11月就此问题进行全民投票。

enDef: showing a lot of respect and admiration

example.en: a hushed reverent voice
example.cn: 毕恭毕敬的低语声

example.cn: 罗马别墅的重现

example.cn: 你通过一个声誉好的经销商来买车是明智的。

example.cn: 有些鸟兽会回吐食物以喂哺幼崽。
